review.why: Edits existing marketing copy in seven focused passes, with a point-edit mode and a check that removes common AI-sounding patterns.
review.summary: Picks an edit mode first (rebuild, restore a voice, or a point edit that touches only one line). Full edits run seven sweeps: clarity, voice, so what, prove it, specificity, emotion, zero risk, looping back after each. It adds an expert panel score, quick word and sentence checks and an AI-tell table with fixes.
strengths: Point-edit mode keeps small requests small
AI-tell check names patterns and how to fix them from the facts
Each sweep has a process and a loop-back rule
cautions: Seven sweeps plus a panel is heavy for short copy
Checklist and refresh guides are in files not read here
